page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a-nps1.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and there are no onboard GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests. Multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores fall within the average tier. Memory subsystem performance is notable, with the PassMark memory score ranking in the top 25%, though uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidths remain in the average range. Cryptographic operations benefit from hardware-accelerated instruction sets including AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on external network-attached storage, which is constrained by the 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and strong memory performance, this instance is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads such as database operations, caching layers, and enterprise applications that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
